changelog:
Initial release of hcc-meta-ai skill for AI-assisted meta-analysis in hepatocellular carcinoma research:

- Introduces a validated six-element prompt framework for structuring all meta-analysis stages.
- Covers literature screening, eligibility assessment, Newcastle–Ottawa Scale (NOS) scoring, baseline, and outcome data extraction.
- Supports multiple advanced large language models (GPT-5.2, GPT-4o, DeepSeek V3.1).
- Provides adaptable, disease-agnostic workflow templates and terminology references.
- Includes a web platform link for deploying the standardized workflow.
